news.title: 1 dead, 5 injured after crash on busy highway in Gwinnett County
news.summary: Triple Team Traffic’s Mike Shields learned the crash happened on Highway 316 at Sugarloaf Parkway around 1:25 a.m. Traffic Tracker 2 cameras showed multiple police and fire vehicles on the scene.

news.title: DNA match links Florida convict to 2016 DeKalb kidnapping, assault
news.summary: A 42-year-old man was extradited to DeKalb County after a grand jury indicted him on charges of rape, aggravated sodomy and kidnapping in connection with a 2016 cold case.

news.title: Ex-Atlanta minister arrested in multi-state child grooming probe
news.summary: A former Atlanta youth minister faces federal child exploitation charges after allegedly abusing and grooming minors across nearly two decades, federal authorities announced.

news.title: Missing Georgia Tech student found safe
news.summary: Georgia Tech police say a first-year student who has been missing since Sunday has been found safe.

news.title: 2 injured, 1 critical after shooting outside NW Atlanta restaurant
news.summary: A shooting outside a northwest Atlanta restaurant early Thursday morning left two men hospitalized, including one in critical condition, according to Atlanta police.

news.title: Man shot in the head, another injured after shooting in northwest Atlanta, police say
news.summary: Police are investigating multiple scenes they believe are connected to the shooting.

news.title: Longtime employee charged with burglary, business owners heartbroken
news.summary: Mableton business owners have learned that one of their employees has been charged with stealing from the restaurant.

news.title: MARTA bus involved in crash near Langhorn Street and I-20
news.summary: Officers are on scene investigating a crash involving a MARTA bus near Langhorn Street on Wednesday night, according to the Atlanta Police Department.

news.title: Suspect arrested after chase ends in PIT maneuver on I-75 in Whitfield County
news.summary: A multi-county chase ended on I-75 South in Whitfield County after deputies performed a PIT maneuver to stop the suspect on Wednesday afternoon, according to the sheriff's office.

news.title: 14-time convicted felon sentenced to federal prison for stolen gun
news.summary: A 14-time convicted felon with a decades-long violent criminal record has been sentenced to nearly nine years in federal prison after Atlanta police caught him with a stolen gun.

news.title: Georgia Supreme Court keeps stay in place for death row inmate, meaning execution will not happen Wednesday
news.summary: Late Tuesday, a Cobb County judge paused the execution to allow time for a hearing on whether the Survivor Justice Act applies to Humphreys' case.

news.title: Mother pleads for answers in 2022 murder of Georgia State freshman
news.summary: An Atlanta family stood side-by-side with police officers on Wednesday to plead for the community's help in solving the December 2022 murder of a 19-year-old college student.

news.title: Suspect wanted in connection with Edgewood Ave. mass shooting arrested out of state
news.summary: FBI Atlanta said Ze'Kevious Perry was taken into custody at a home in Montgomery, Alabama. An FBI SWAT team made the arrest.

news.title: Family desperate for answers nearly 4 years after 19-year-old killed in Atlanta apartment shooting
news.summary: The family has also been distributing flyers throughout the apartment complex, hoping someone who knows what happened will provide information.
